game.name: Approximately Up
game.intro: Approximately Up is a co-op space sandbox where you build a fully modular spaceship out of whatever bolts together long enough to fly. Mount giant thrusters, annoying cables and everything in between, explore new planets, complete wild missions and argue with your crew. Build, crash, rebuild.
keyFacts: Build, crash, rebuild — a fully modular spaceship from scrap
Co-op multiplayer exploration of new planets
Mount giant thrusters, cables and everything in between
Official 14 languages including EN/中文/日本語/한국어/FR/DE/ES
aboutPoints: Assemble a modular spaceship from parts that barely hold together
Explore new planets with friends in co-op multiplayer
Complete wild missions and survive the dangers of space
